name: Abda (Hungary)
description: White field with a panel of alternating blue and white horizontal stripes at the hoist, charged in the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Abda: a crowned red and blue shield with a church, a bridge and a wavy stripe, above a red scroll inscribed ABDA.
history: The arms and flag of Abda were redesigned and adopted by the representative body in 1995. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Abda arms with crown and scroll
